description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Certificate of Exemption to Fairway Urban Homes under Sri Lanka Electricity Act
reasoning: This gazette contains a notice from the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka issuing a Certificate of Exemption under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). This constitutes a regulatory action and falls under legal/regulatory matters involving statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements, making it Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazette).
